newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Sale of Dutch cocoa plant to Octide cancelled.
newsitem.headline: Sale of Dutch cocoa plant to Octide cancelled.

text.p: Dutch Cocoa & Chocolate Holding BV said on Wednesday the previously announced sale of its Dutch Cocoa BV unit to Ivory Coast's Groupe Octide had been cancelled.

"The management of Dutch Cocoa and Chocolate Holding have negotiated with the Ivorian group for quite some time, but the talks between the two parties have not led to the anticipated result," Dutch Cocoa said in a statement.

The company said that, given the failure of the sale, it had decided to further develop its cocoa activities on its own. Its policy would now focus on building a new cocoa factory with a greater capacity, it said.
Dutch Cocoa is based in Haarlem, Netherlands, employs 50 people and turns over around 66 million guilders per year. --Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
